title: best-execution-review
description: Structured second-line best-execution surveillance record. Tabular by nature: review identification, scope, venue inventory, aggregate execution-quality metrics, Rule 605 / 606 reconciliation, trade-by-trade exception sample, conflict review, committee record, fund-board attestation (fund-adviser variant), findings, and KRI trends. Downstream consumers: the next-quarter surveillance reads prior-period exceptions, conflicts, findings, and KRIs to populate prior-period columns and roll findings forward; fund-board-reporting reads the fund-by-fund §15(c) attestation block; adviser-exam-readiness reads the surveillance summary into the EXAMS document-request response file.

review_id.description: Stable identifier for the surveillance review. Reused across periods so the next-quarter review can pull prior-period rows for trend tracking.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the engagement-scope record under which this review was produced. Empty string if scope was not formalised.

firm_registration.description: Registration class. Drives which rule lattice loads (§206 fiduciary; FINRA Rule 5310 .09; both for dual; the IA limb plus §15(c) and §17(e) / §28(e) blocks for fund advisers).

cadence.description: Review cadence label. Descriptive string such as 'quarterly', 'monthly+quarterly+annual', 'quarterly-into-fund-board', 'annual'.

audience.description: Primary audience for the surveillance read-out. Descriptive string.

owner_role.description: Role responsible for producing the surveillance. Role, not person.

approver_role.description: Role that signs off the surveillance disposition. Role, not person.

method.description: Sample method narrative (stratified by asset class and order type, random, risk-based, 100% off-NBBO, etc.). Names the strata over-represented in the tail (block trades, illiquid securities, after-hours, conflicted-routing flow).

venues.description: Venue inventory and changes during the period.

venue_type.description: lit-exchange, dark-ATS, wholesaler, single-dealer, dealer-network, etc.

aggregate_metrics.description: Aggregate execution-quality metrics, one row per (venue × asset_class × metric).

metric.description: Effective-over-quoted ratio, price improvement per share, at-or-better fill rate, average effective spread (bps), market-on-close fill rate, large-block slippage vs arrival mid (bps), distance from competitive quote (bps for fixed income), net liquidity capture (options), etc.

source.description: TCA vendor name, internal report identifier, venue 605 file reference.

rule_605_606_reconciliation.description: Rule 605 and 606 reconciliation block. Applicable where the firm is a BD subject to those rules or uses BDs whose 605 disclosures form part of the evidence.

release_34_99679_compliance_status.description: For periods governed by the March 2024 amendments — operative compliance status for this firm and period.

reconciliation_status.description: match / divergence Y%; investigation status; remediation note.

order_type.description: market, marketable-limit, non-marketable-limit, midpoint-pegged, retail-improvement, etc.

miss_type.description: off-NBBO fill; price-improvement miss vs alternative venue; large-block routing decision; principal-trade pricing; agency-cross unfavourable to one side; soft-dollar-eligible flow routed to PFOF venue with weaker price improvement; other (describe).

factor_analysis.description: Factor walk under the applicable rule lattice. For BD reviews: Rule 5310 .01 factors (character of market, size and type of transaction, number of markets checked, accessibility of quotation, terms and conditions). For IA reviews: IA fiduciary factors (price, speed, likelihood, size, market impact, accessibility, total transaction costs, customer instructions). Dual registrants walk both.

conflict_review.description: Conflict-as-input review, one row per conflict type in scope.

conflict_type.description: PFOF; principal_trades_206_3; agency_cross_206_3; affiliated_brokerage_17e; soft_dollars_28e; commission_sharing_arrangement; other_inducement.

magnitude.description: Period magnitude — dollar value received for PFOF; count and notional for principal trades and agency crosses; share of fund commissions for affiliated brokerage; commission dollars for soft dollars; accumulated and disbursed for CSAs.

weighed_in_determination.description: How the conflict was factored into the best-execution determination, with reference to the committee minutes that captured the weighing.

disclosure_consistency_check.description: Match against Form CRS, Form ADV item 12, Rule 606 disclosure as applicable.

dissents_recorded.description: Description of dissents, or explicit 'no dissents recorded'.

fund_15c_attestation.description: Fund-adviser variant only. One row per fund the surveillance covers, feeding the §15(c) board materials.

comparable_rate_evidence_pin.description: Reference to the §17(e)(1) comparable-rate evidence file or workpaper.

severity.description: Descriptive severity calibrated to firm norms; not a forced enum.

kris.description: Headline KRIs trended across at least four prior periods where available.

period_prior_values.description: Up to four prior-period values, oldest first.

trend_direction.description: Descriptive: improving, stable, deteriorating, n/a (insufficient history).
